description:
1.	Remove railing separating courtyard of Stables from Phase 1. 
2.	Proposed landscaping scheme to courtyard. 
3.	Demolish and rebuild the gables in matching brick and chamfered plinth detailing with 1 No x Large Window and 2 No x small window either side. 
4.	Full height glazed windows to south facing elevation in frameless system. 
5.	Create double height space in central range from ground to first to show case the clock tower. 
6.	Glazing to first floor doorways (loading doors) – original doors to be retained in a fixed position on the facade.
7.	Amend proposed building section so Building 7 and 8 are on the same level and adjust associated vertical transport strategy (stairs/lift).

Condition : 1 - Time limit

The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - In accordance with drawings and documents

The development shall be carried out in accordance with [Drawings:  M047-VER01-B08-00-DR-A-880-001 Rev P03; M047-VER01-B08-01-DR-A-880-002 Rev P02; M047-VER01-B08-ZZ-DR-A-190-001 Rev P05; M047-VER01-B08-XX-DR-A-190-002 Rev P05; M047-VER01-B08-XX-DR-A-190-003 Rev P09; M047-WAL04-B08-ZZ-DR-S-045-002 Rev P02; M047-VER01-B08-XX-DR-A-190-004 Rev P06; M047-VER01-B07-XX-DR-A-190-001 P03. 
Documents: 
- Cover Letter prepared by St George, dated 11 September 2025; reference: PP-14315383;
- Morphological Drawings Ground Floor and First Floor, Drawing number: 550 Rev A/P-01; 
- Ram Brewery-Phase II Stable Block Significance Package; reference: M047- HER11- B08- XX- DR- A- 045- 500 Rev P02.
- Wandsworth Mills London SW18, The Stables, M047-INT-SW-Design & Access Statement dated June 2025; prepared by: St George ]. 

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - Details of Shell & Core Works

Prior to commencement of any building works, details of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with Historic England. 
a) Methods of ensuring the safety and stability of the retained building fabric throughout construction works.   
b) Other than a gentle nebulous water spray, methods to be used to clean the masonry of the buildings, including but not limited to render removal method . 
c) Methods of repointing/brick repair if any required including mortar sample. 
d) Extent and methods of existing timber repairs if any. 
e) Extent and methods of existing roof repairs if any. 
f) Construction and demolition work to the listed buildings including, but not limited to:  
 i) Retained internal walls
 ii) Proposed internal walls including service and access cores
 iii) Internal demolition 
 iv) Retentions of interior floor finishes
 v) Extent & details for any new floors 
 vi) Retention of ceilings and timber roof structure as well as their proposed retained patina
 vii) Any replacement and additional roof coverings including works to replace Braithwaite tank
 viii) Inventory of the retained internal fixtures and fittings, such as feed chutes, historic fire, buckets, tools, signs, panelling and any other features identified in the submitted report titled: 'Ram Brewery-Phase II Stable Block Significance Package; reference: M047- HER11- B08- XX- DR- A- 045- 500 Rev P02' 

The works shall be implements in accordance with the approved details.
 
Reason: To ensure the preservation of the special interest of the building affected by the works hereby approved, in accordance with policy LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - Details of Fitout Works

Prior to commencement of any fitout works, details of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with Historic England
a) Proposed locations of the retained internal fixtures and fittings, such as feed chutes, historic fire, buckets, tools, signs, panelling and any other features identified in the submitted report titled: 'Ram Brewery-Phase II Stable Block Significance Package; reference: M047- HER11- B08- XX- DR- A- 045- 500 Rev P02' 
b) Position, type and method of installation of all new and relocated services and fixtures. 
c) details of all proposed internal joinery and mouldings at a scale of 1:5 for mouldings and 1:20 for joinery.
d) Methods to secure and protect retained fixtures and fittings and interior features.  

Reason: To ensure the preservation of the special interest of the building affected by the works hereby approved, in accordance with policy LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 5 - Photographic Evidence

Prior to commencement of any building works, photographic recordings of the buildings externally and internally to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The approved record shall be deposited with Historic England and Local History Library. 

Reason: To ensure the preservation of the special interest of the building affected by the works hereby approved, in accordance with policy LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 6 - Materials 

For each relevant phase of the development details of materials, samples and representative detail drawings to a scale of not less than 1:20 for all listed buildings, including fixtures and fittings and interior features shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development of that phase or such other timetable as agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development should be implemented in accordance with the approved details. 

Reason: To ensure a high quality of development in compliance with Local Plan Policy LP3.
Condition : 7 - Identifying Contracts

The works of demolition or alteration by way of partial demolition hereby approved shall be carried as per contracts agreed under planning permission 2023/0688 unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority. New contract(s) for the carrying out of the completion of the relevant phase of works for which consent is hereby granted, including the works contract, shall be submitted to and accepted in writing by the Council as Local Planning Authority or an alternative means of ensuring the Council is satisfied that demolition within the relevant phase will only occur immediately prior to development of the new building works within that phase has been accepted in writing by the Council as Local Planning Authority. 

Reason: To ensure a high quality of development in compliance with Local Plan Policy LP3. 
Condition : 8 - No new plumbing

No new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents or ductwork (which are not shown on the hereby approved drawings) shall be fixed to the external faces of the listed buildings unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All new external rainwater goods and soil pipes on the visible elevations of the retained buildings shall be cast iron, painted black unless otherwise approved in writing.

Reason: To ensure a high quality of development in compliance with Local Plan Policy LP3.
Condition : 9 - No new appurtenances

No new grilles, security alarms, lighting, cameras or other appurtenances shall be fixed on the external faces of the listed buildings unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority under this condition or associated permission. 

Reason: To ensure a high quality of development in compliance with Local Plan Policy LP3.
Condition : 10 - New facing brick to match existing

New facing brickwork shall match existing brickwork in terms of brick, bond and pointing and no re-pointing of brickwork is authorised unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

Reason: To ensure a high quality of development in compliance with Local Plan Policy LP3.
Condition : 11 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
Condition : 12 - INFORMATIVE: Written schemes of investigation will need to be prepared and implemented by a suitably qualified archaeological practice in accordance with Historic England Greater London Archaeology guidelines.  They must be approved by the local planning authority before any on-site development related activity occurs.
Condition : 13 - INFORMATIVE: Community Infrastructure Levy (CIL): From the information available, it appears that the development permitted is subject to a Community Infrastructure Levy charge in accordance with the Community Infrastructure Levy Regulations 2010 (as amended). Any assessment of CIL liability by the Council has been based on the information provided and is not intended to provide a binding estimate of the actual CIL liability likely to be incurred.  General information on the Community Infrastructure Levy, including the forms that should be submitted to the Council can be found on the Council�s website.
Condition : 14 - INFORMATIVE: The details covered by Condition 3 & Condition 6 will constitute the works detailed for preparing the Stables or fitout prior to Occupation as detailed in the Section 106 agreement dated 6th December 2013 under Schedule 8 Clause 1.1.

INFORMATIVE: The discharge of condition 3 relating to this permission, will also comply with conditions 5, 12 and 13 of planning permission reference 2015/6416. 

INFORMATIVE: The discharge of condition 5 relating to this permission, will also comply with condition 2 of planning permission reference 2015/6416. 

INFORMATIVE: The discharge of condition 6 relating to this permission, will also comply with condition 3 of planning permission reference 2015/6416. 

INFORMATIVE: The discharge of condition 7 relating to this permission, will also comply with condition 4 of planning permission reference 2015/6416. 

INFORMATIVE: The discharge of condition 8 relating to this permission, will also comply with condition 8 of planning permission reference 2015/6416.

2012/5290 dated 6th December 2013.
Demolition of curtilage listed buildings, bottling plant, canteen building, warehouses, gatehouse and rear stables pursuant to development of retail (Class A1-A4), and residential (Class C3) uses and partial demolition of the Church Row Curtilage buildings pursuant to the formation of the river walkway. Partial demolition, internal and external alterations of listed buildings: Stable Block, Brewery Complex, and Brewers Lodge pursuant to the change of use to retail (Class A1-A4), retained small scale brewery use (Class B2), museum (Class D1) and creation of new residential units (Class C3) at the Ram Brewery, Wandsworth London (Amendments to LBC ref 2012/5290 dated 06/12/2013).
